v.verdict: The detail pane now shrinks to its content with a lime top bar and the right side no longer looks like an empty stretched panel, but the volume rows are still mixed into the raid list, the value column is still centred, and the whole screen is still a flat, generic list.

findings.where: middle list, from 'master volume' to 'footsteps volume' (y 710-990)
findings.what: The audio rows still sit under the 'the raid' tab, after an unlabelled gap and a hairline. The audio tab exists in the left column, so the same settings appear to live in two places, and the list is 20 rows long with no group names.
findings.fix: Move the volume rows under the 'audio' tab. If groups have to share a tab, add a 16px tx-2 group label with 24px of space above it, and keep about 9 rows of 56px per screen.

findings.what: About 580px under the pane is empty and the pane is only 290px tall, so the right third of the screen is dead. A 10px hint line stays above it. There is no preview, no list of the value choices, and no default marker.
findings.fix: Use the space under the card for the value choices as a stacked list with the current one marked in lime, or a 'default: off' line at 16px tx-2. Otherwise narrow the pane to 480px and centre it vertically.

findings.what: The values and arrows are centred in a 300px band, far from the setting names at x 354. The eye has to cross about 350px of nothing on each row. The idle arrows are dim, and 'open' has no arrows, so it looks like a different kind of control.
findings.fix: Right-align the value group to x about 1020 with 24px between arrow and value, or pull it to x 560-860. Use tx-2 at 4.5:1 or better for idle arrows, and give 'open' a bordered chip with a '›' marker.

findings.where: left tab column, 'the raid' and 'send play data'
findings.what: The selected tab carries a lime edge and a raised fill while the list row also carries lime, so there are two lime markers at once and the eye splits. 'send play data' floats after a large unexplained gap.
findings.fix: When focus is in the list, dim the selected tab to tx-1 with a 2px edge in --ui-line-hi. Put a 1px --ui-line divider and 24px of space above 'send play data'.

findings.what: The thumb is 8px wide and touches the panel border. The scrolled part has no bottom fade, so the last row, 'footsteps volume', is cut flat against the footer line, and you cannot tell more rows follow.
findings.fix: Make the thumb 6px in --ui-line-hi with a 4px gap from the border, and add a 32px bottom fade to --ui-panel on the list.

findings.where: detail card, 'key: left of 1' chip and description
findings.what: The card uses 4 type styles, and the 'off' value in 56px grey is the only large element but is dim (tx-2 on dark) while the title is brighter. The chip is a bordered button-looking box that cannot be pressed, and the description sits 12px from it.
findings.fix: Make the hero 'off' tx-1, or lime when the value is on. Turn the key chip into plain 16px tx-2 text with no border, and use 24px between the description and the key line.

findings.where: footer 'esc close' and header rule (y 100 and 995)
findings.what: The footer legend is 14px and tx-2, and only shows close; it gives no hint for the pad (change value, back), and the rule at y 995 is closer to the list than the list is to the header. The top-left lime fragment at x 28-60 of the card border looks like a rendering error.
findings.fix: Add 'a change  b back' next to close at 16px. Match the header and footer spacing at 16px. Remove the stray lime tick, or make it a full 3px top bar across the card.

v.verdict: The screen is clean and consistent: card, x, tabs and one lime action are all in place. It is still a small centred form in a huge empty card, with a weak headline and a primary button that does nothing yet.

findings.where: headline '0 runs, 0 notes ready to send'
findings.what: The counts are not the hero. The whole line is the same 32px weight, so the numbers do not stand out and nothing says the state is empty. The previous advice was not followed.
findings.fix: Set the numbers at 56px f-cond 800 in tx-1 and the labels 'runs' and 'notes' at 16px tx-2 under or beside them. When both counts are 0, dim the line to tx-2.

findings.what: The lime primary action is lit even though there is nothing to send (0 runs, 0 notes). Lime then no longer means 'the one useful action', and 'show data' sits right next to it with a tight 8px gap.
findings.fix: When the counts are 0, disable copy to clipboard and show data: use the --ui-raised fill, tx-2 text, no lime. Set the gap between buttons to 16px.

findings.what: The content column is centred at about 1100px under a title and tabs aligned to the 48px margin, so the left edges do not line up. Below the restore panel, about 400px of the card is empty.
findings.fix: Align the column's left edge to x=48, or cap the card at about 1200px for this tab. Fill the height with a status block (last send time, run count) or shrink the card to fit its content.

findings.what: The amber sentence 'paste a restore code, replaces your save.' is a full sentence on screen. It is amber and bold at 16px and competes with the panel title. The panel has the same fill as the card, so it reads as a box with no hierarchy.
findings.fix: Cut it to the tag 'replaces your save' in --warn at 16px, on the title row at the right. Make the title 20px tx-1. Use --ui-raised fill with 24px padding.

findings.where: pil1... input and read code button
findings.what: The input is 54px tall and 1050px wide, while 'read code' is a small button below it, left-aligned and squeezed 16px under the input. The placeholder is dim. The input has no focus border.
findings.fix: Put 'read code' to the right of the input as a 56px-tall button, with the input at 56px height. Set the placeholder to --tx-2. Give the focused input a 2px --acc border.

findings.what: The danger button sits far to the right of the safe actions with 600px of empty space between, so it looks detached. Red outline plus red text at 16px is loud next to the quiet buttons.
findings.fix: Move it into a danger zone below the restore panel, separated by a 1px --ui-line divider, or keep it on the row but dim the border to --danger at 60% until focused.

findings.what: The inactive tab 'game' is a dim grey, a little low in contrast. There is a stray lime tick at the card's top-left corner (x 27-60, y 25). The tabs are 16px, far smaller than the 32px title next to them.
findings.fix: Set the inactive tab to --tx-2 (#aaa498) at 20px f-cond 600. Remove the stray lime tick or turn it into a full-width 2px card top border.

findings.what: The footer legend is tiny and sits at the bottom right with a full-width divider above it. There is no pad button hint, although the screen is meant to be played from a couch.
findings.fix: Show 'b back' in the same footer on pad at 16px tx-2. Keep 'esc close' for keyboard use. Make both 16px minimum.
